Name: Artemas
Role: Messenger to be sent to Titus
Summary: Artemas was one whom Paul planned to send to Titus in Crete, so that Titus could then come to Paul at Nicopolis.
KeyStory: Artemas was one whom Paul planned to send to Titus in Crete, so that Titus could then come to Paul at Nicopolis.
LifeLesson: Relief workers in the gospel allow others to move on to the next task.
